```python

This was converting pytz timezones to dateutil tzfile objects. My change converted them to ZoneInfo instead. Both approaches break the test since neither preserves the original pytz tzinfo.

I should restore the original pytz handling (converting to dateutil tzfile via TzinfoParser), since that's what the existing code did and the test expects that behavior.
